scope: Renderer state integration in a Node VM with the unchanged source, mocked DOM and IPC; no real model/API or Electron execution.

tests.name: same_jd_preserves_inflight_state
tests.evidence: Same-JD save preserves request ID, boundary, completed draft, history and the in-progress answer; cancellation count stays zero.

tests.name: different_jd_resets_answer_context_only
tests.evidence: JD B cancels the old request and clears answer state while retaining historical transcript and reusable background.

tests.name: stale_nonempty_delta_ignored_after_switch
tests.evidence: Old start/question/nonempty delta/done/error events cannot repopulate answer, question, or draft state.

tests.name: current_nonempty_delta_positive_control
tests.evidence: The same callback path accepts and renders a nonempty delta for the active request; the rejection test is not passing because delivery is disconnected.

tests.name: stale_interleaving_does_not_replace_new_answer
tests.evidence: Interleaving stale events with an active new answer neither replaces the answer nor ends the new generation; only the valid completion becomes a draft.

tests.name: same_jd_preserves_completed_context
tests.evidence: Saving the same current JD preserves the completed answer, one current draft, history, request ID and context boundary.

performedBy: Codex, during portfolio evidence review on 2026-09-16 (Asia/Shanghai).
